ALLOWED_INTERPRETATION: A non-directional description of the range of a scheduled or calendar-defined hour or day relative to a named ordinary-conditions comparator, with the nuisance diagnostic deciding whether the state is more than the general volatility regime.

R03-A.FAMILY_NAME: EVENT_RESPONSE / scheduled derivative settlement (not FOMC, CPI or NFP)
R03-A.TITLE: Scheduled derivatives-expiry clock

R03-B.FAMILY_NAME: CROSS_SECTIONAL / true panel (not D9 share, not D13 relative momentum)
R03-B.TITLE: Cross-sectional panel breadth and dispersion states

R03-C.FAMILY_NAME: PARTICIPANT_CLOCK_ANCHORING / session structure (not the D12 DST profile shift)
R03-C.TITLE: Session and participant-clock structure

CLASSIFICATION.DISCOVERY: PROMISING_PROTOTYPE iff statistical and practical pass and the epoch gate does not fail; NO_INCREMENTAL_STRUCTURE if statistical or practical fails; HETEROGENEOUS_UNEXPLAINED if only the epoch gate fails
CLASSIFICATION.FINAL: SUPPORTED_UNCONDITIONAL iff PROMISING_PROTOTYPE and REPLICATED (SUPPORTED_BUT_PRODUCT_SPARSE if the frequency gate fails); PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_NOT_REPLICATED if the replication fails; PROMISING_PROTOTYPE if no replication surface is available in this unit
CLASSIFICATION.REPLICATION: BitMEX 2017-2019, same frozen rule, Holm over the replicated prototypes of the card; REPLICATED iff statistical and practical pass

ESTIMAND: mean over units of d = mean z(state) - mean z(comparator)
FORBIDDEN_AFTER_OUTCOMES: any change to a window, state, comparator, unit, standardization or seed
any added hypothesis, regime, horizon or sign
any rescue of a closed hypothesis
FORBIDDEN_INTERPRETATION: No direction, no trade, no target, no probability of direction, no causal claim about dealers, hedgers or any participant group, no generalization beyond the venue and years tested.

GATES.EPOCH: calendar years; block-permutation Q test (2000 draws, seed 20261004 + index, alpha 0.05) and opposite-sign test; fails the card only if the compiler recorded the gate ASSESSABLE
GATES.NUISANCE_WORDING: adjusted estimate (prior 24h RV, lagged target) keeps >= 0.5 of the raw estimate with the same sign, else REFLECTS_GENERAL_VOLATILITY_REGIME
GATES.PRACTICAL: |estimate| >= 0.5 SD with the declared sign (any sign for TWO_SIDED)
GATES.PRODUCT_FREQUENCY: at least 12 evaluated units per year on average

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 08:00-09:00 UTC on Monday-Thursday of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Deribit settles every listed option and future at 08:00 UTC on Fridays. Dealers and basis traders unwind hedges and roll positions into and out of that hour, so the hour carries more price discovery than the same hour on other weekdays.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: WEEKLY_EXPIRY_HOUR
HYPOTHESES.REPLICATION_NOTE: Deribit expiries ran at 08:00 UTC through 2017-2019; BitMEX XBTUSD 5m bars.
HYPOTHESES.STATE: Friday 08:00-09:00 UTC, the Deribit weekly, monthly and quarterly expiry hour

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 08:00-09:00 UTC on the other Fridays of the same calendar month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Monthly and quarterly expiries carry much larger open interest than weeklies. If the expiry-hour effect scales with settled notional, the last-Friday hour should exceed the ordinary weekly expiry hour.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: LARGE_EXPIRY_INCREMENT
HYPOTHESES.STATE: 08:00-09:00 UTC on the last Friday of the calendar month (monthly and quarterly expiry)

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: The hour starting 16:00 London time on the other Fridays of the same month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: CME Bitcoin futures settle to the CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate computed over 15:00-16:00 London on the last Friday. Basis and cash-and-carry positions close around that fixing, and the hour after it absorbs the unwinds.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: CME_EXPIRY_HOUR
HYPOTHESES.REPLICATION_NOTE: CME BTC futures listed 2017-12-18; replication covers 2018-01..2019-12 only.
HYPOTHESES.STATE: The hour starting 16:00 London time on the last Friday of the month (CME Bitcoin futures final settlement on the BRR)

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 04:00-08:00 UTC on Monday-Thursday of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Into a large options expiry, dealer gamma hedging near popular strikes pins the spot price, so the pre-expiry window should show a narrower range than the same window on other weekdays.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: PRE_EXPIRY_PINNING
HYPOTHESES.STATE: Friday 04:00-08:00 UTC, the four hours before the Deribit expiry

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: Other eligible UTC days of the same calendar month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: High dispersion means idiosyncratic repricing dominates the common factor. That ends when the common factor moves; the next BTC day should carry a wider range.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: RETURN_DISPERSION_HIGH
HYPOTHESES.STATE: UTC day whose cross-sectional SD of daily log returns across the eligible panel is at or above its trailing-180-day 0.80 quantile

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: Other eligible UTC days of the same calendar month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: When nearly every symbol moves the same way, the move is a common-factor shock. Common shocks cluster, so the next BTC day should carry a wider range.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: BREADTH_SYNCHRONY
HYPOTHESES.STATE: UTC day whose |fraction of eligible symbols with a positive daily return - 0.5| is at or above its trailing-180-day 0.80 quantile

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: Other eligible UTC days of the same calendar month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: A broad volume shock across the panel signals a change in participation that is not specific to one coin; it should carry into the next BTC day.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: VOLUME_SHOCK_FRACTION
HYPOTHESES.STATE: UTC day whose fraction of eligible symbols with quote volume at or above 2x their own trailing-30-day median is at or above its trailing-180-day 0.80 quantile

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: Other eligible UTC days of the same calendar month
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Days when activity concentrates in altcoins describe a different participant mix. Whether BTC's next-day range is wider or narrower on such days is not known, so the claim is two-sided.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: BTC_SHARE_LOW
HYPOTHESES.STATE: UTC day whose BTC share of eligible-panel quote volume (BTC included) is at or below its trailing-180-day 0.20 quantile

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: The same UTC hour of Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Traditional-finance participants and their funding rails are closed at the weekend, so the hourly range should be narrower hour for hour.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: WEEKEND_HOURS
HYPOTHESES.STATE: Every UTC hour of Saturday and Sunday

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 09:30-10:30 America/New_York on Tuesday-Thursday of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Information that accumulates over the weekend is priced by US-session participants when they return; the first US-open hour of the week should carry a wider range than the same hour later in the week.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: MONDAY_US_OPEN
HYPOTHESES.REPLICATION_NOTE: BitMEX 2017-2019; NYSE closures are not pinned for those years, so Monday closures are not excluded there.
HYPOTHESES.STATE: Monday 09:30-10:30 America/New_York, excluding Mondays that are NYSE full-day closures

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 09:30-10:30 America/New_York on the other non-closure weekdays of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: On a US holiday the US equity session does not open, so the hour that usually carries the US open should show a narrower range.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: NYSE_CLOSURE_US_OPEN
HYPOTHESES.REPLICATION_NOTE: No pinned NYSE calendar for 2017-2019; replication NOT_AVAILABLE.
HYPOTHESES.STATE: 09:30-10:30 America/New_York on a weekday that is a NYSE full-day closure

HYPOTHESES.COMPARATOR: 15:00-16:00 America/New_York on Tuesday-Thursday of the same ISO week
HYPOTHESES.MECHANISM: Before the weekend, participants who cannot manage risk over two closed days square positions in the last regular US hour of the week.
HYPOTHESES.NAME: FRIDAY_US_CLOSE
HYPOTHESES.REPLICATION_NOTE: BitMEX 2017-2019; NYSE early closes are not pinned there, so no exclusion is applied.
HYPOTHESES.STATE: Friday 15:00-16:00 America/New_York, excluding Fridays that are NYSE closures or early-close days

STOPPING_RULE.PRODUCT_EXPOSURE_HANDLING: The beta product shows no panel breadth, dispersion, volume-shock or BTC-share statistic. No product exposure of these states exists; if one is added before the stop, the prospective leg is void and needs a new preregistration.

STANDARDIZATION: per calendar year and per window definition, over all days' windows of that definition (label-blind)
TARGET: log range ln(max high / min low) over the window; a window with a missing bar is UNAVAILABLE from timestamps only
